api_token.invalid: The API key is not valid, has been revoked or has expired.
api_token.scope: This API key does not have the {scope} permission. Create a key with that permission in Integrations.
api_token.rate_limited: This API key has gone over its limit of requests per minute. Try again in {seconds} s.

footer.why: Atesta sends you this notice because of your role in the organization. It holds only titles, dates and links; the details are in the app.
footer.optional: To stop this type of notice: {url}
footer.critical: This is a security notice for owners and admins; it cannot be turned off.

revoked.subject: Atesta: a connection lost its access
revoked.body: {org}: Atesta no longer has access to a {provider} connection. Consent may have been revoked or the app deleted in the tenant. Meanwhile its automated evidence is not refreshed.

extra.subject: Atesta: a connection has too many permissions
extra.body: {org}: a {provider} connection holds more permissions than the read-only ones Atesta needs. Atesta does not scan it until they are removed.

scan_problem.subject: Atesta: a scan did not finish
scan_problem.body: {org}: a {provider} scan did not finish after its retries. That connection's automated evidence is not refreshed until it is fixed.

incident_clock.subject: Atesta: an incident reporting deadline
incident_clock.due: The deadline has passed and is not recorded as met in Atesta.

due_digest.subject: Atesta: {count} upcoming due dates
due_digest.intro: {org}: these are due in the coming days.
due_digest.control_review: Review of the control “{title}”: expires on {date}

weekly.subject: Atesta: weekly summary
weekly.quiet: No changes this week: no scans, no connections with problems and nothing due soon.
weekly.score: {percent} of requirements passed in the recorded checks
weekly.not_an_assessment: Note: this is not a conformity assessment.
weekly.scans: Scans in the last 7 days: {ok} finished, {problems} with problems.
weekly.due: Due in the next 7 days: {soon}. Overdue: {overdue}.
